text:
Maya: Heads up — there is a lonely jar of maraschino cherries in the mini-fridge and no label. Anyone claim it?
Aj: Not mine. But 3 cherries are gone already so someone is bingeing on sundaes at 10am. :eyes: 
Sam: I confess, but only the top two. Sorry. I left a post-it. 
Maya: Post-its blow away in the fridge. We need a proper snack etiquette. 
Katie: Could we do a simple coffee-credit ledger? I keep getting charged for oatmilk I didn’t use. :grimacing: 
snack-bot: Reminder: add item to pantry list with /pantry-add <item> <qty> — helps auto-reorder. 
Aj: Love a ledger. Can we make it low-friction? A whiteboard next to the kettle + a 30s rule. 
Maya: Draft suggestion: if you take something communal, either replace, add a note, or chip in $1 in the coffee jar.
Sam: Or a digital sheet. I keep forgetting cash. Maybe a tiny Google Form that updates a sheet. 
Katie: Poll: oatmilk restock — Almond, Oat, or Soy? Reply with A/B/C.
Maya: A (Oat)
Aj: B (Almond) — voting for variety
Sam: B
Katie: C (Soy) — for the die-hards
Maya: Looks like Almond wins… barely. I'll order a small pack.
Aj: Quick idea: label the mini-fridge shelves with names for communal vs personal. Personal items go on the top shelf with a name sticker. Communal on bottom. 
Sam: Also can we put a tiny sign: “Don’t pilfer the cherries” — that one is hilarious.
Katie: I put this quick ledger snippet in case we want to start with something simple:
```
FRIDGE LEDGER
- Coffee jar: $12.00
- Oatmilk (2): $6.00
- Maraschino cherries: communal (please replace)
- Granola (personal): Sam
```
Maya: Can someone volunteer to be Snack Steward this week? Responsibilities: order basics, keep ledger, refill coffee bin. 10-15min/wk.
Aj: I'll do this week. Also will label the fridge tonight.
Sam: Thanks Aj! I'll replace the cherries I ate and leave an apology sticker.
Katie: Adding reminder: if you bring in a big pastry box, please post in #kitchen with the number of pieces. Saves the morning stampede. :cupcake: 
Maya: Perfect. Aj — ping us when you add the ledger link so we can all chip in digitally. 
Aj: Will do. Also, if anyone sees a mystery Tupperware with lasagna — it's been claimed by no one, so throwaway on Friday unless someone shrieks.
Sam: I shriek. That's mine, I swear.
Katie: Closing note: thank you for being kind to the coffee machine. It hears us. :coffee:
Maya: Meeting adjourned. Snack Steward Aj, godspeed. :trophy:
